source_visibility_model: npm package source is visible to users; safety depends on explicit exclusion and scanning, not obfuscation
candidate_count_rule: Keep the package surface focused on runnable CLI/runtime, clearly labelled maintainer/readiness checks, Prism availability, closeout/revive/status/diagnose support, and public handoff docs. The alpha readiness surface may temporarily include repo-governance checks needed by diagnose/spec-check, but they are not normal end-user workflow; formal public release must either trim them or introduce a separate maintainer package profile.
manual_release_boundaries: Do not set package.json private=false in P4-2d.
Do not set runtime-package-readiness publish_allowed=true in P4-2d.
Do not choose a public distribution license without Norven's explicit legal/product decision.
Do not claim RedCap is public-release-ready before the historical asset physical cleanup release gate is satisfied.
Do not run npm publish or mutate npm registry state in P4-2d.
Do not claim RedCap is public-release-ready while license, runtime layout, or formal release task boundaries remain open.
